run_passage_embedding_generation: run the CLI to generate passage embeddings from a TSV file using a pretrained Retriever model
run_embed_passages_function: run the embed_passages function to encode a list of passages into vector embeddings using a model and tokenizer
run_sharded_embedding_generation: run the script with shard_id and num_shards to split embedding generation across multiple workers
review_embed_passages_function: review the embed_passages function that batches passages through a DataLoader and collects embeddings via model.embed_text
review_main_function: review the main function that loads a Retriever model, shards passages, generates embeddings, and saves them as pickle
